events.name: Boston Red Sox at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Jarren Duran hit a grand slam in the 11th inning, Mickey Gasper had his first career two-homer game and the Boston Red Sox beat the Miami Marlins 7-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarren Duran hits grand slam in 11th inning and Red Sox sink Marlins 7-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Max Clark hit his first home run at Comerica Park and five Tigers pitchers combined to allow one run as Detroit ended a six-game losing streak with a 4-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Clark, pitching staff help Tigers end six-game losing streak with 4-1 win over Rays

headlines.description: — Hunter Goodman homered in his return from a shoulder injury, Mason Adams worked into the fifth inning in his big league debut, and the Colorado Rockies snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 3-1 victory over the Washington Nationals on Tuesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Goodman hits 35th homer in his return to the lineup as Rockies snap skid with 3-1 win over Nationals

events.name: Houston Astros at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez went 3 for 5 and lined a go-ahead triple in the eighth inning off Brent Headrick as the Houston Astros beat the New York Yankees 9-7 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yordan Alvarez hits go-ahead triple in 8th inning as Astros outlast Yankees 9-7

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Salvador Perez drove in two runs, Seth Lugo gave up one run in five effective innings, and the Kansas City Royals beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-3 on Tuesday night to extend their winning streak to nine games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lugo works 5 innings, Royals beat Blue Jays 5-3 to extend winning streak to 9 games

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor made a diving catch at shortstop with the bases loaded in the ninth inning and scored the winning run on a throwing error in the 10th to lead the New York Mets past the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Francisco Lindor leads resurgent Mets to 3-2 victory over MLB-best Brewers in 10 innings

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies singled in the go-ahead run with two outs in the eighth inning and the Atlanta Braves defeated Los Angles 4-3 on Tuesday night, snapping the Dodgers' six-game winning streak in a matchup of first-place clubs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Albies drives in winning run in the 8th, Braves win 4-3 to snap Dodgers' 6-game winning streak

events.name: Texas Rangers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters hit a two-run double off Jacob deGrom during Chicago's six-run first inning, and the White Sox held off the Texas Rangers 11-7 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tristan Peters stars as the White Sox beat Jacob deGrom and the Rangers 11-7

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso had four hits, including a three-run homer, and drove in four runs before leaving the game in the fifth inning, and the Baltimore Orioles routed the swooning St. Louis Cardinals 13-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Alonso homers and drives in 4 before leaving game as Orioles rout Cardinals 13-1

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — José Ramírez drove in five runs with three doubles, Steven Kwan had five singles and the streaking Cleveland Guardians overcame an early five-run deficit to beat the Los Angeles Angels 8-6 in 10 innings Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ramírez has 5 RBIs and Kwan gets 5 hits to rally streaking Guardians past Angels 8-6 in 10 innings

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Ryan Waldschmidt hit a game-winning, two-run homer with two outs in the ninth inning and the Arizona Diamondbacks rallied to stun the Chicago Cubs 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Waldschmidt hits game-winning 2-run HR with 2 outs in 9th to send D-backs past Cubs 5-4

headlines.description: — Carlos Cortes homered and Gage Jump struck out nine in 6 1/3 innings as the Athletics beat the Minnesota Twins 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gage Jump strikes out 9 and Carlos Cortes homers to lift the A's over the Twins 4-2

headlines.description: — Cal Raleigh tied a team record with homers in four straight at-bats, George Kirby pitched one-run ball into the eighth inning and Seattle Mariners beat the Philadelphia Phillies 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raleigh continues homer barrage, Kirby fans 9 as Mariners beat Phillies 4-1

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Oneil Cruz hit the first homer allowed by Mason Miller in over a year with two outs in the ninth Tuesday night, sending the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 1-0 victory over the San Diego Padres.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oneil Cruz homers off Mason Miller in 9th, sending Pirates to a 1-0 win over Padres

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers hit his 28th homer, a drive that bounced into McCovey Cove, and reliever Anthony Molina worked 4 1/3 scoreless innings as the San Francisco Giants beat the Cincinnati Reds 3-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers bounces a homer into McCovey Cove as Giants beat Reds 3-1
